1	import { daysBetween } from './dates.js';
2	import { balanceDue } from './payments.js';
3	
4	/**
5	 * Get overdue invoices report.
6	 * @param {Array} invoices - Array of invoice objects
7	 * @param {string} asOf - Report date in YYYY-MM-DD format
8	 * @returns {Array} Array of { number, customerId, dueDate, daysOverdue, due } sorted by daysOverdue descending
9	 */
10	export function overdueInvoices(invoices, asOf) {
11	  const overdue = invoices
12	    .filter((inv) => (inv.status === 'issued' || inv.status === 'partially_paid') && inv.dueDate < asOf)
13	    .map((inv) => ({
14	      number: inv.number,
15	      customerId: inv.customerId,
16	      dueDate: inv.dueDate,
17	      daysOverdue: daysBetween(inv.dueDate, asOf),
18	      due: balanceDue(inv),
19	    }))
20	    .sort((a, b) => b.daysOverdue - a.daysOverdue);
21	
22	  return overdue;
23	}
24
